title.name: RO_WEB Runtime Handler Registry
title.purpose: Shared handler taxonomy for all player skills. Formula data lives in Runtime Profiles; handlers are reusable.

physical_damage.description: Weapon/physical damage, hit count, knockback and status chance.

magic_damage.description: RA Renewal MATK-based single/multi-hit, elemental, splash and status magic.

passive.description: Recalculated passive stats and conditional bonuses.

timed_status.description: Buff/debuff/status with duration and level values.

ground_area.description: Persistent or instant ground-targeted area effects; ground damage and ground debuff executors are available.

toggle.description: Toggle state with activation/cancellation; Camouflage is executed through castBuffSkill toggleBuff.

mount.description: RO_WEB mount state and future atlas swap hook.

special_review.description: Skill requires custom flow or unsupported systems.

physical_attack.description: RA Renewal weapon damage through the common physical pipeline.

physical_attack_formula.description: RA Renewal physical skill with a named shared formula branch.

misc_damage.description: BF_MISC/fixed or special-source damage through the common pipeline.

buff.description: Self-target timed or immediate beneficial status.

ground_debuff.description: Enemy-position persistent or one-shot status field; supports delayed trigger, knockback and Runtime status effects.

movement.description: Player movement skill; map bounds apply, wall collision is intentionally omitted.

steal_item.description: Steal one eligible item from the current monster drop table.

steal_zeny.description: Steal a percentage of the current monster final rated Zeny reward.

skill_copy_selector.description: Open the RA CopyFlags-filtered copy selection UI and write to an extra-skill slot.

follow_area.description: Periodic area effect centered on and following the player.

monster_debuff.description: Apply grouped non-stacking debuff components to the current monster.

ground_damage.description: Enemy-position persistent or one-shot damage field using the shared physical/magic/misc damage pipeline.

inspect_monster.description: Read current monster level, HP, race, element, size, ATK, DEF and MDEF without damage.

chain_magic.description: Renewal magic that repeatedly hits and bounces between nearby enemy targets.

dispel.description: Remove dispellable Runtime statuses and grouped effects from the current enemy target.

ground_protection.description: Create a persistent area that removes and blocks eligible ground magic effects.

soul_exchange.description: Renewal monster-target Soul Exhale branch: once per monster, restore a percentage of player MaxSP.

summon_control.description: Open the shared assist-only virtual summon control UI.

falcon_toggle.description: Equip or release the assist-only falcon state.

falcon_detect.description: Reveal hidden monsters and hunter traps around the current target position.

falcon_spring_trap.description: Spring one eligible hunter trap near the current target position.

warg_toggle.description: Equip or release the assist-only warg state.

warg_sensitive_keen.description: Reveal and damage hidden monsters and remove hunter traps around the player.

trap_detonator.description: Detonates Hunter/Ranger GroundEffectManager traps around the selected target position.

virtual_summon.description: 召喚或替換 assist-only 虛擬戰鬥夥伴；支援元素、仿生、FAW 與 ABR。可執行攻擊或恢復／防禦支援，無地圖實體、HP、SP、EXP 與受擊判定。

virtual_summon_dismiss.description: 解除指定家族的 assist-only 虛擬召喚物；目前用於 FAW解體。

independent_summon.description: 不占主要虛擬召喚夥伴欄位的計時召喚物／裝置；支援地獄植物週期攻擊與氣泡蟲延遲自爆。

homunculus_manager.description: 開啟人工生命體選擇／管理 UI；確認選擇時建立 BaseLv 快照並召喚至專用生命體欄位。

homunculus_rest.description: 使專用生命體欄位中的活動生命體進入安息，保留選擇資料。
